workflowEditorSchemaChecks.semanticValidation: C++ additionally checks graph, type references, origins and budgets

initialize.instructions: Local development POC. No production quota or commerce. Experimental unauthenticated HTTP/SOCKS5 proxies. Batches are non-atomic; inspect per-item results and never replay unknown outcomes. Tools share origin and lease checks.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Report implemented technical-preview capabilities and unsupported features

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Read component and local ownership health without starting browsers or changing quotas

tools.name: profile_list
tools.description: List owned profiles; active by default, or choose a lifecycle state

tools.name: profile_create
tools.description: Create an isolated development profile with explicit origin scope

tools.name: profile_update
tools.description: Update a stopped profile using optimistic revision control

tools.name: profile_archive
tools.description: Archive a stopped, unreferenced active profile without deleting its data

tools.name: profile_trash
tools.description: Move a stopped, unreferenced profile into the recycle bin

tools.name: profile_restore
tools.description: Restore an archived or recycled profile with its original identity and data

tools.name: profile_purge
tools.description: Permanently delete recycled data; repeat the exact profile ID to confirm

tools.name: browser_start
tools.description: Start a new owned browser process tree

tools.name: browser_status
tools.description: Read process ownership and handshake version

tools.name: browser_stop
tools.description: Stop only this managed process tree; no payment or lease required

tools.name: lease_acquire
tools.description: Acquire exclusive local automatic control

tools.name: lease_revoke
tools.description: Revoke prior control generation before manual takeover

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate within the explicit profile origin scope

tools.name: page_snapshot
tools.description: Read a bounded main-frame accessibility tree with document-bound refs

tools.name: page_locate
tools.description: Locate exactly one CSS element in the main document

tools.name: page_discover
tools.description: Find bounded visible function candidates without clicking or reading field values

tools.name: page_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a unique element and create action drafts without reading field values

tools.name: page_preview
tools.description: Observe current action conditions without scrolling or dispatching page actions

tools.name: page_clear_highlight
tools.description: Clear the managed page debug highlight without changing page styles

tools.name: page_pick_start
tools.description: Select an element with Chromium native overlay; selection click is intercepted

tools.name: page_pick_read
tools.description: Read selected main-document element and unique CSS candidates without clicking

tools.name: page_pick_stop
tools.description: Stop element selection without replaying any click; no lease required

tools.name: page_fill
tools.description: Fill an input without echoing or logging its value

tools.name: page_fill_secret
tools.description: Fill using an origin/profile scoped SecretRef without returning the value

tools.name: page_click
tools.description: Dispatch click; business success must be asserted separately

tools.name: page_select
tools.description: Select exact, unambiguous native option values without echoing them

tools.name: page_text
tools.description: Read bounded element text for assertions

tools.name: page_wait_text
tools.description: Retry read-only observation until exact text matches

tools.name: page_screenshot
tools.description: Capture authorized page as PNG base64

tools.name: page_list
tools.description: List managed pages and adopt authorized popups of managed pages

tools.name: page_open
tools.description: Open and select a managed page inside the allowed origin scope

tools.name: page_switch
tools.description: Select a managed page; old element references are invalidated

tools.name: page_close
tools.description: Close one managed page without stopping the owned browser

tools.name: browser_events
tools.description: Poll bounded metadata events with explicit cursor gaps; no live subscription

tools.name: browser_reconnect
tools.description: Explicitly reconnect the same owned process without replaying page actions

tools.name: browser_diagnostics_start
tools.description: Start bounded console, exception and network metadata observation before actions

tools.name: browser_diagnostics_read
tools.description: Read metadata diagnostics and step associations; payloads are omitted

tools.name: browser_diagnostics_stop
tools.description: Stop collecting diagnostics and retain the bounded in-memory records

tools.name: recorder_start
tools.description: Observe main-document actions as parameterized metadata; no field values

tools.name: recorder_read
tools.description: Read bounded recording events and an unvalidated draft; no page actions

tools.name: recorder_control
tools.description: Pause, resume or stop and detach the main-document recorder

tools.name: workflow_repair_draft
tools.description: Review one selector replacement bound to the exact source hash; never publish or replay

tools.name: page_extract
tools.description: Read public main-document scalar data using an explicit bounded Schema dialect

tools.name: page_batch
tools.description: Prevalidate and execute ordered actions; unknown outcomes force a stop without replay

tools.name: workflow_validate
tools.description: Validate bounded workflow DSL, graph, input types, capabilities and optional input

tools.name: workflow_publish
tools.description: Publish a validated immutable workflow version with its SHA-256

tools.name: workflow_list
tools.description: List local immutable workflow versions

tools.name: workflow_get
tools.description: Read an owned published workflow definition

tools.name: workflow_run
tools.description: Start a fixed workflow version asynchronously; disconnect does not cancel it

tools.name: workflow_status
tools.description: Read secret-free run checkpoints and actual step outcomes

tools.name: workflow_runs
tools.description: Find local run IDs after a client disconnect without replaying business actions

tools.name: workflow_debug
tools.description: Configure exact flow/step breakpoints and inspect redacted variables only at paused boundaries

tools.name: workflow_control
tools.description: Pause at a step boundary, resume a paused run or cancel without business replay

tools.name: credential_create
tools.description: Store a scoped secret protected by Windows current-user DPAPI; never returns its value

tools.name: credential_list
tools.description: List credential metadata only; no plaintext or ciphertext

tools.name: credential_rotate
tools.description: Rotate a secret using optimistic revision control; existing scope remains fixed

tools.name: credential_delete
tools.description: Delete a credential using optimistic revision control

tools.name: credential_audit
tools.description: Read bounded secret-free credential access audit with monotonically increasing sequence

tools.name: model_configure
tools.description: Configure an HTTPS or loopback OpenAI-compatible completion endpoint with durable conservative budgets

tools.name: model_status
tools.description: Read model configuration and secret-free durable budget and outcome history

tools.name: model_generate_workflow
tools.description: Generate and validate a workflow draft without publishing or executing it; no automatic retry

tools.name: site_package_preview
tools.description: Validate data-only site package, capabilities, routes, workflow hashes and review import differences

tools.name: site_package_import
tools.description: Install an immutable validated site package version using optimistic version control; does not run workflows

tools.name: site_package_list
tools.description: List installed site package versions and hashes

tools.name: site_package_export
tools.description: Export one exact installed data-only package version and its hash
